text.p: These are the leading stories in the Egyptian press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- President Hosni Mubarak says in an exclusive interview with al-Ahram "there are 18 new industrial cities now in Egypt." Mubarak said that he agreed with President Bill Clinton on holding a bilateral meeting to push the peace process forward.
- Mubarak to deliver an important speech at the opening session of the Middle East and North Africa Economic Conference.
- President Mubarak to meet Palestinian President Yasser Arafat and U.S. Secretary of State Warren Christopher on Tuesday morning.

- An Israeli and Egyptian arrested for spying for the Israeli intelligence Mossad. Security authorities held the Egypian and the Israeli, who is of Arab origin, for being charged with spying for the Mossad. Spying equipment were found with them. The defendans are being interrogated at the higher state security prosecution. The public attorney ordered them remanded for 15 days.
- After the weekly cabinet meeting, Information Minister Safwat el-Sherif said that highest priority is given to the project of creating a new delta in the Western Desert.
